# Revolut

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 2 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: consumer-bank marketing and signed-out login chrome: Revolut UI ships as --rui-* custom properties, a light marketing home (accent #234fa6, ink #1f1f1f, Aeonik Pro display, Inter body, 9999px pills) and a dark set the pricing page and the SSO wall both resolve (accent #6fa0ff, page #000000, grouped background #00010a).

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing pages and the SSO sign-in wall only. The phone field was not filled. No account was created. No card, email, passkey, Google, or Apple flow was started.. Themes: light, dark.

Public signed-out surfaces of [revolut.com](https://www.revolut.com/), captured 2026-11-19. The home page was light (`html[data-theme=light]`). The pricing page was dark (`html[data-theme=dark]`). Log in opened `https://app.revolut.com/start` and redirected to `https://sso.revolut.com/signin`. That wall was measured and not submitted. No phone number, email, card, passkey, or KYC step was entered. No account was created.

The measured viewport was 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, `devicePixelRatio` 2, visual viewport scale 1. That is the preview tab's fill size, not a 1440 or 390 pass.

## Typography

16 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Aeonik Pro, Inter.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Aeonik Pro is the marketing face (`--rui-font-marketing`). It loaded at weight 500 on the home page. Weight 700 was declared and not loaded. Inter is the brand face (`--rui-font-brand`) and loaded. The system stack is `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Arimo, sans-serif`. Neither Aeonik Pro nor Inter is committed. They are Revolut's fonts.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The hero `h1` computed to 82.6351px with tracking -2.08px at this viewport. The token scale's marketing display1 is 3.5rem (56px). Both are measured. The token is the declared role. The 82px size is the fluid heading at 1169px, recorded on `light.text.hero`'s source string.

Resolved font weights on the marketing site differ from the declared custom properties. Body declared 400 and computed 500. Display declared 700 and computed 800. Tokens use the resolved weights.

`--rui-easing-linear` computed to the quoted string `"linear"`. It is listed under `$extensions.notTokenised`, not stored as an easing.

SSO `Continue with email` was a 40px icon button. Its accessible name was "Continue with email". The visible word "Email" sat in a sibling. The 40px circle is the measured control.

`preview.cover` is [icon.png](icon.png) because no page screenshot exists.

- **The foundation scales have no file behind them.** The type, radius, space, size, shadow and motion scales and most painted-chrome values were read in the capture session, but no `raw/foundation.json` was kept. Only the `--rui-color-*` dumps are in [raw/](raw). The builder labels every Measured token whose value raw/ does not hold, with its opacity, "Reconstruction" (87 tokens). A coincidental match, such as a 4px step that also appears in a colour dump, keeps the old label.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the pill buttons.** Log in is black on white type, Sign up is white on black type, both `9999px`, padding 10px 24px, Aeonik Pro 500. See `light.button` in [tokens.json](tokens.json).
- **Use Aeonik Pro for display and Inter for UI text.** The SSO Continue button is Inter 500 at 15px, not Aeonik. See `core.font`.
- **Keep the two accents apart.** Light marketing accent is `#234fa6`. Dark marketing and the SSO wall use `#6fa0ff`. See `light.accent` and `dark.accent`.
- **Do not treat the hero size as the display token.** 82.6351px was the fluid heading at 1169px. The role token is 56px.
- **Do not invent a screenshot.** The frame failure is recorded above. A grey PNG would look like evidence.
- **Do not copy the wordmark, card art, or Aeonik Pro into something that ships.**
